validated_results.title: Association of polymorphisms in folate metabolic genes and prostate cancer risk: a case-control study in a Chinese population.
validated_results.reason: The study examines polymorphisms in folate metabolic genes (MTHFR, MTR) and prostate cancer risk, with no population-wide folic acid intake or status exposure estimate.

validated_results.title: Prostate Cancer Working Group report.
validated_results.reason: This is a working group consensus report discussing screening, soy/isoflavone hypotheses, and treatment recommendations without original soy-prostate cancer incidence results.

validated_results.title: Defining the Optimal Selenium Dose for Prostate Cancer Risk Reduction: Insights from the U-Shaped Relationship between Selenium Status, DNA Damage, and Apoptosis.
validated_results.journal: Dose-response : a publication of International Hormesis Society
validated_results.reason: The reported findings derive exclusively from canine experiments on selenium status, prostatic DNA damage, and apoptosis ("Our work in dogs has revealed a U-shaped dose response").

validated_results.title: Defining the Optimal Selenium Dose for Prostate Cancer Risk Reduction: Insights from the U-Shaped Relationship between Selenium Status, DNA Damage, and Apoptosis.

validated_results.reason: Vitamin E appears only as commentary on the SELECT trial within an animal (dog) model study, providing no human original data.

validated_results.title: Selenium and vitamin E for prostate cancer: post-SELECT (Selenium and Vitamin E Cancer Prevention Trial) status.
validated_results.reason: The article explicitly reviews and discusses studies done before and since SELECT rather than reporting original selenium-prostate cancer incidence data.

validated_results.title: Selenium and vitamin E for prostate cancer: post-SELECT (Selenium and Vitamin E Cancer Prevention Trial) status.
validated_results.reason: The vitamin E content is a narrative review of prior preclinical and clinical evidence and SELECT trial parameters, not an original human study.

validated_results.title: Evaluation of the influence of polymorphic variants CYP1A1 2B, CYP1B1 2, CYP3A4 1B, GSTM1 0, and GSTT1 0 in prostate cancer.
